target_customer: Engineering and R&D teams with a measurable evaluation metric for a hard optimization problem
problem: Solving hard engineering problems requires expert researchers to try many approaches by hand; an autonomous system can generate, test and evolve thousands of approaches cheaply.
business_model: Forward-deployed AI research service sold by demo and engagement (pricing not public)
product_category: Autonomous AI research and optimization engineer

founders.name: Richard Zhou
education: University of Waterloo, CS, dropped out
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: international medalist in math and robotics; published at ICLR and EMNLP before 20.

founders.name: Ray Xu
education: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, CS, dropped out
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: LLM research in reinforcement learning, post-training and retrieval; twin brother of Richard per YC description.

competitors.name: AlphaEvolve (Google DeepMind)
competitors.what: LLM driven evolutionary coding agent for algorithm discovery, closed source
competitors.traction_then: Set the circle packing benchmark Aemon claims to beat (2025 result)

competitors.name: OpenEvolve
competitors.what: Open source reimplementation of AlphaEvolve, released May 2025
competitors.traction_then: about 5,000 GitHub stars per one unconfirmed source

competitors.name: ShinkaEvolve (Sakana AI)
competitors.what: Open source sample efficient evolutionary algorithm discovery

technical_complexity.rationale: Evolutionary search with LLMs and cheap verification works on well specified problems but is research grade for general customer codebases.

defensibility.rationale: Open source clones (OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve) and DeepMind compete; the company's advantage is speed and cost, which are easy for others to match.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Open source alternatives existed by mid 2025; no incumbent action against Aemon is documented.

market_need_then: AlphaEvolve in 2025 showed LLM driven discovery could beat human records, and open source clones drew developer interest, indicating demand for the approach.

identity.voice_and_tone: Research lab framing, leads with a record claim

branding.brand_signature: Circle packing world record claim under 10 USD of compute (company claim)
branding.community_and_virality: A HUGE magazine feature (March 2026) repeats the record claim from the company's own account.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable proof point and a magazine feature, but no independent verification of the claim and no evidence of broader brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Aemon is a Winter 2026 YC company founded by twin brothers who dropped out of university and who claim a record on circle packing for under 10 USD of compute. Open source and DeepMind competition is strong, so the result depends on turning benchmark wins into paid engineering engagements. An aggregator lists a pre-seed in March 2026, unverified; no outcome yet.
notes: Funding: VCBacked reports a March 2026 pre-seed with YC, Pioneer Fund and Afore Capital as investors and Preqin lists a March 18, 2026 deal with undisclosed amount; both aggregators, no press release found, so no round is recorded. Another tracker reports 500K USD total, unverified. YC page names Richard Zhou as founder; Ray Xu appears on the YC launch bio and a directory. The record claim is the company's own and not independently replicated. Prior employers not listed. Completeness pass: The pre-seed round (amount undisclosed) rests on databases only (VCBacked, Preqin dated 2026-03-18); the 8M AEON round belongs to a different company.
